mark.label: Verified by id.ldas.jp
mark.tooltipSelfDeclared: Verified by id.ldas.jp: {{method}}. The name shown is self-declared by the provider.

filter.label: Verified providers only
filter.hint: Showing only providers verified by id.ldas.jp. Turn this off to see everything that has been published.
filter.hintAll: Showing all providers, including those not verified by id.ldas.jp.
filter.unavailable: The list of verified providers could not be loaded, so all providers are shown.

apply.title: Apply to become a verified provider
apply.description: Present your id.ldas.jp credential to be listed as a verified provider.
apply.intro: Providers listed here get a "Verified by id.ldas.jp" mark in the catalogue. You apply by presenting your id.ldas.jp credential. The portal checks it, and the operator then reviews your application before listing you.
apply.publishedTitle: What will be published if you are listed
apply.publishedName: Your name, as it appears in your id.ldas.jp credential
apply.publishedMethod: How you were verified (for example "u-tokyo.ac.jp domain" or "ORCID") and whether the name is self-declared
apply.notPublished: Your credential itself is not stored or sent anywhere. Only the items above are passed to the operator.
apply.consent: I understand that applying means I agree to the items above being published in the provider registry.
apply.needWallet: Connect your wallet first (button in the page header). The wallet in your credential must be the wallet you connect here.
apply.submittedBody: Your credential was checked and your application was sent to the operator. You will be listed after the operator has reviewed it. Nothing is published yet.
apply.errorTitle: The application could not be completed
